label: College Students & Gen-Z
purchase_trigger: Flash sales, viral social trends, aesthetic college fashion, pocket-money discounts
platform_behaviour: Highly deal-driven; browses extensively at night (10 PM - 1 AM); heavy cart saving and coupon hunting.

label: Young Working Professionals
purchase_trigger: Premium brand trust, fast 2-day delivery, office-ready styles, weekend festival shopping
platform_behaviour: Values quality and reliable sizing; converts rapidly on weekend mornings; lower cart abandonment.

label: Homemakers & Family Curators
purchase_trigger: Festival preparation, family gifting, vernacular video demonstrations, durable materials
platform_behaviour: Builds seasonal wishlists 2-3 weeks before major festivals; responds strongly to vernacular reviews and WhatsApp shares.

label: Value & Budget Shoppers
purchase_trigger: BOGO offers, free shipping under ₹500, deep festival discounts, COD availability
platform_behaviour: Strict price threshold checker; high drop-off if shipping fees appear; waits for mega sale midnight drops.

label: Young Parents (Tier-2/3)
purchase_trigger: Seasonal kids wear, festival family matching outfits, cotton comfort, safety ratings
platform_behaviour: Frequent repeat purchases; shops during afternoon downtime (1 PM - 4 PM); highly influenced by peer parent reviews.
